scenes.text: This is hot edit. It lets you edit any HTML report right in your browser, and it saves every change straight back into the file.
An AI wrote this report. Press Option E, click any text, and just type. The cursor lands exactly where you click.
Select a block to restyle it. Give it a new background, a border and rounded corners, and see it update as you go.
Click a chart to edit it. Switch the chart type with a single click. Then tune the colours, and it redraws live.
Chart JS, Vega Lite and Mermaid diagrams work the same way. Change a number in the data table, and the bars re-sort instantly.
Maths and diagrams open as their source, so the file never fills up with frozen output.
Add new blocks with the plus button. Then drag the handle to move anything into place.
Or just ask an AI. Select one block and say what should change. Only that block is touched, and it lands live, without a reload. The panel shows which model answered.
It's a chat, so you can keep going with a follow-up. The AI remembers what you asked before.
Hot edit works with your coding agent too. Install the skill once. From then on, every report your agent writes opens in hot edit, ready for you to edit.
And through it all, your file stays clean. Every edit is a small patch, so the diff shows exactly what changed.
Hot edit. Try it now with N P X hot edit demo.
